---
title: "Helper Pages"
format: html
---

Helper pages are optional support pages that sit between the cover and the main
workflow.

Use a helper page when operators need shared context that does not belong to a
single procedure page, for example:

- credential setup;
- cluster access notes;
- repeated shell commands;
- reusable helper code;
- warnings about institutional or platform constraints.

## Authoring Notes

Do not add helper pages by default. If a manual can stay clear without them, the
manual should stay smaller.
